description: Owner-only: enable or disable automatic off-session payments. Enabling requires active Paid access. NEVER enable without explicit human approval for USD 9 plus tax per 1000 top-up credits, which carry over while Paid and expire on downgrade to Free, refill below 100 credits, and the chosen gross USD monthly limit. Set consent off_session_v1 only after that approval; null when disabling. Read current revision first. Preserve the original idempotency key and payload after uncertainty. A saved Stripe card may require setup_url. Disabling prevents new payment initiation; in-progress payments may finish. This does not create a subscription or Paid access.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
